jobDescription:
Verve Commerce is looking for a Mid-Level React Engineer to join our growing product team. You will own feature development end-to-end, work closely with product designers, and contribute to our component library.

Responsibilities:
- Develop and maintain complex React applications with TypeScript
- Build reusable components and maintain a shared design system
- Optimize frontend performance including bundle size and rendering speed
- Write unit and integration tests using Jest and React Testing Library
- Participate in code reviews and provide constructive feedback
- Collaborate with backend engineers to integrate RESTful APIs

Requirements:
- 2+ years of experience with React and TypeScript
- Strong understanding of component lifecycle and hooks
- Experience with state management (Redux, Zustand, or Context API)
- Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and Git workflows
- Excellent communication skills and ability to work in an agile environment

Nice to have:
- Experience with Next.js or Remix
- Knowledge of accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1)
- Contributions to open-source React projects
